questions.question:
What will be the value of the given expression if ‘A’ means ‘+’, ‘B’ means ‘–’, ‘C’ means ‘×’, and ‘D’ means ‘÷’?

27 D 3 A 5 A (9 C 6) B 15 A (14 B 11) C 6 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Decoding the information, 

 
 

 
 
**Sign**

 
 
 
A

 
 
 
B

 
 
 
C

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
**Means**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

Given:

27 D 3 A 5 A (9 C 6) B 15 A (14 B 11) C 6 = ?

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

27 ÷ 3 + 5 + (**__9 × 6__**) - 15 + (__**14 - 11)**__ × 6

= **__27 ÷ 3__** + 5 + 54 - 15 + 3 × 6

= 9 + 5 + 54 - 15 + __**3 × 6**__

= **__9 + 5 + 54__** - 15 __**+ 18**__

= __**86 - 15**__

= 71

Hence, **“71”** is the correct answer

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

questions.solution:
The Logic followed here is:

(2nd number ÷ 1st number) × 2 = 3rd number

**In **(9, 45, 10)

⇒ (45 ÷ 9) × 2 = 5 × 2 = 10

Similarly,

**Option 3 → (8, 72, 18)**

**(2ⁿd number ÷ 1st number) × 2 = 3rd number**

**⇒ (72 ÷ 8) × 2 = 9 × 2 = 18**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(8, 72, 18)".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

G _ C T _ X _ T G X _ T _ X C T G _ C T

options.text: T G C C G G
X G C C G X
X X C G G Y
X G C C C G

questions.solution:
Given: G _ C T _ X _ T G X _ T _ X C T G _ C T 

By checking options and substituting accordingly:

1) T G C C G G → G **T** C T / G X C T / G X C T / G X C T / G **G** C T 

**2) X G C C G X** → G **X** C T **/** **G** X **C** T / G X **C** T / **G** X C T / G **X** C T 

 
• *Here "G X C T" is repeated itself.*

3) X X C G G Y → G X C T / **X** X C T / G X **G** T / G X C T / G **Y** C T 

4) X G C C C G → G X C T / G X C T / G X C T / C X C T / G **G** C T 

 
• *Option (2) gives a pattern of **G X C T** - G X C T - **G X C T** - G X C T - **G X C T.***

Hence, ‘X G C C G X’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The total of the salary of Mandeep and Swati is ₹85,000. The total of the salary of Swati and Yukti is ₹60,000. If Swati's salary is ₹10,000 more than the salary of Yukti, then what is the salary of Mandeep?
questions.solution:
Given:

**1) The total of the salary of Mandeep and Swati is ₹85,000.**

=> Mandeep + Swati = 85,000 ------------ (i)

**2) The total of the salary of Swati and Yukti is ₹60,000.**

=> Swati + Yukti = 60,000 ------------ (ii)

**3) Swati's salary is ₹10,000 more than the salary of Yukti.**

=> Swati = 10000 + Yukti

=> Yukti = Swati - 10000

**Putting this value in equation (ii)**

=> Swati + Swati - 10000= 60000

=> 2 × Swati = 60000 + 10000

=> Swati = 70000 ÷ 2

=> Swati = 35000

**Putting the salary of Swati in eq. (i)**

=> Mandeep + 35000 = 85,000

=> Mandeep = 85000 – 35000

=> Mandeep = 50000

Hence, The salary of Mandeep is **“50000”.**85:T97

• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

Option (1) D → E is opposite to D.

**Option (2) C → A is opposite C.**

Option (3) B → F is opposite to B.

Option (4) F→ B is opposite to F.

Hence, ‘Option (2)’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Seven friends S, T, U, V, W, X and Y, are sitting around a circle with their backs towards the centre. There are three persons between Y and V. W is sitting to the immediate right of V. U is sitting between Y and X. T is not the neighbour of W or Y. S is the neighbour of W.

Who is sitting between V and X?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven friends sitting around a circle with their back to the centre: S, T, U, V, W, X and Y

1) W is sitting to the immediate right of V.

2) There are three persons between Y and V.

**There are two cases that generate first case Y sitting fourth left to V and second case Y sitting fourth right to V**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b309e41eeeea7e355fa93a12f58f73fb682db7158afdb05004d7261ab7483621.png] 

3) S is the neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa23dc101577320eb929034e3f7c8aae5cc05c24247b643985013bbb10c6f0fe.png] 

4) U is sitting between Y and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ebd6185b3c5ac7ab00a95e80a49a40c915de5299835faa0f78d57966d300ccf.png] 

5) T is not the neighbour of W or Y.

In the second case, only one position is left which is near Y, so the second case is not possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e27706577d75895e90352b9efb0dac4f71fd1dca6d884f3be92cc683c3ffde.png] 

Hence, “T” is sitting between V and X.

questions.question: Eight officers A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are attending a meeting sitting clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence.
